persona.name: Ana
persona.archetype: Accessibility: keyboard-only, low vision, reduced motion
persona.bio: 41, accessibility consultant with low vision (uses 150% zoom) and RSI that makes mouse use painful. Plays narrative and cozy games with keyboard. Enables reduced motion everywhere.
goals: Play the core loop using only the keyboard (Tab, Shift+Tab, Enter, Space, Escape, arrows)
Check the game respects reduced motion
persona.readingStyle: Reads carefully. Checks contrast, focus visibility, labels and live announcements.
persona.skills: Keyboard only. Must NOT use click/tap commands — only `key` commands (Tab, Enter, Space, Escape, arrows, WASD). May use `look` and `shot` freely to see where focus is.
researchQuestions: Can every core action be reached by keyboard? Is focus always visible?
Can staff/characters in the 3D scene be selected without a mouse?
Is text readable at 150% and are status changes announced?
Does reduced motion calm the animations (wiggling buttons, camera)?
quirks: Keeps a list of WCAG issues with criterion numbers
Uses Escape to back out of everything

text: Title card at 150% — the big card already fills the viewport; Open the doors is below the fold. First Tab lands on Cat, but the tool says no visible focus ring. The selected yellow border may be all I get.

Actually there IS a change: the Cat tile went from a gold border to a thin dark border on focus. Subtle, but visible. Arrow keys don't move through the grid though, so 15 critters = 15 Tabs to get past.

events.text: Bunny

text: Took about 22 Tabs to reach Open the doors, partly because selecting Bunny threw focus back to the top. It scrolled into view with a clear blue ring though.

text: I can see Hire, Staff, Rivals and Town right there, but the keyboard can't hold onto them. Enter on Settings did nothing because focus was already gone.

WCAG 2.1.1 Keyboard: Shift+Tab reaches 'Settings' but by my next keypress focus has been reset to the page body, so Enter/Space never activates it. Same for Enter on 'Restaurant'. No menu-bar button on the home screen can be activated by keyboard. Suspect a per-tick re-render that drops focus (the next-tick countdown rolled over between presses); on the title screen focus persisted fine.

text: Quit point. Keyboard-only I cannot open Hire, Staff, Rivals, Town or even Settings, so Hire, the service challenge, Town walking and Settings all stay untested. A sighted mouse user would be fine; I am locked out of the whole game after the welcome popup.
Locked out after the welcome popup. Charming game I can only watch.

oneSentence: A gorgeous, calm-looking critter bistro that a keyboard-only player can enter but cannot play: focus is wiped back to the page body between every keypress on the home screen.
favoriteMoment: The welcome popup put focus right on Let's cook with a clear blue ring, and after reload Shift+Tab jumped straight to Open the doors.
worstMoment: Pressing Tab six-plus times and landing on Restaurant every time; Shift+Tab reaches Settings but Enter on it does nothing because focus is already gone.
quitPoint: Home screen right after the welcome popup: no menu-bar button (Hire/Staff/Rivals/Town/Settings) can be activated by keyboard.
confusions: Why focus keeps resetting to the body on the home screen
How to select staff in the 3D scene without tapping
What hustle and the ? counter mean (explained only on hover)
wishlist: Keep focus stable across tick re-renders
Make staff name tags focusable buttons, or a Staff list that selects them in the scene
Arrow-key roving focus in the critter grid and menu bar
Keyboard shortcuts for the menu bar (H, S, R, T)
Stop the title-screen camera orbit under prefers-reduced-motion
